description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gudul Lurker, adding {U}.
When Gudul Lurker dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Gudul Lurker from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Gudul Lurker's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
